title: Paradise Lost
author: John Milton
summary: Milton's epic poem in blank verse retells the biblical fall of humankind, from Satan's rebellion against God to Adam and Eve's expulsion from Eden. Satan emerges as its most vivid and unsettling character.
readIf: you are willing to read dense seventeenth-century verse for its grandeur and its Satan.
skipIf: you want a quick or plot-driven read, since the language demands patience.
